records.label: Numeric equality does not establish identity
records.text: Equal numbers or matching labels in independent protocol, catalogue, implementation, and application namespaces do not establish identity or a join.

records.label: Identity is not address
records.text: An installed Device ID, diagnostic WHERE, and functional WHERE have distinct roles; none may be substituted for another merely because observed values resemble each other.

records.label: slot is not Module or address
records.text: A slot is the numeric position that locates a Module; it is neither the Module itself nor the Module's configured functional address.

records.label: Capability is not runtime state
records.text: Catalogue capability describes what a Device or firmware can support; diagnostic and functional observations describe installed or runtime state and must not be silently substituted for capability.

records.label: WHERE is system-specific
records.text: Resolve the interface variant and WHO before interpreting WHERE; no single universal address grammar applies to every OpenWebNet system.

records.label: Configuration requires resolved context
records.text: A configuration index or value is meaningful only in its resolved Device, firmware, Module, Object, ownership, and operation context.

records.label: Public specification and implementation can differ
records.text: Differences between published protocol documents and versioned implementation artifacts must remain explicit source or version differences, not be silently reconciled.

records.label: Source counts are not protocol limits
records.text: Counts measured in a particular database revision describe that source revision and are not universal protocol maxima or complete product-family counts.

records.label: ZigBee source publication provenance is unresolved
records.text: The supplied ZigBee OpenWebNet specification carries Confidential footers; its public-release provenance remains unresolved even though its interface semantics are used as qualified specification evidence.

OWN-DEV-0019: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0019: Six capacitive zones are six command Modules plus a seventh UI Module. Preserve M3/M4 and BTicino/Arteor electrical scope, M6 cyclic-heading/noncyclic-prose discrepancy, physical I table without corresponding socket and stored SET rather than SPE. Scenario banks, calibration/cleaning/erasure timers and production-specific Classe300EOS restrictions remain distinct; Virgin-only candidates do not prove runtime selection. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Obtain a sanitized fingerprint showing all six button slots plus UI slot `7`. Correlate `DIMENSION 30` Virgin-Object identifiers with software-selected roles on real hardware. Locate direct official documentation for `574091` and `574591`. Determine whether the empty condition `4145` rows have any runtime significance. Correlate wildcard catalogue applicability with observed firmware versions.

records.text: OWN-DEV-0020: Four buttons/LEDs and four logical Modules visualize and force load priorities; they are not four power relays. Conversion references 421/431/441/451 have no EN_CONV_RULE rows; documented product arithmetic does not fabricate their implementation. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Obtain a sanitized four-slot `DIMENSION 30` / `DIMENSION 35` fingerprint from a known panel. Recover or independently establish the missing conversion logic referenced as `421` / `431` / `441` / `451`. Reconcile the documented decimal `P1` / `P2` priority composition with the missing catalogue conversion-rule records before implementing a database-driven converter. Correlate wildcard firmware applicability with observed firmware versions. Check whether phase configuration is surfaced consistently across all six commercial identities.

records.text: OWN-DEV-0055: Dual PIR/US wall product retains Spanish versus MM-c threshold, Auto factory state, remote-route and coverage conflicts plus GermanIP44/12mA versus exactIP42/17mA. Headline77m2 PIR label conflicts with detailed39PIR/77US matrix; Spanish30s sensitivity unit is unresolved. FirmwareA/PL0..9 andS0..4 versusphysical1..9/0..3 remain distinct; IR slots and shared restrictions are not hardware proof. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Coverage, threshold and configuration-route conflicts remain unresolved by a change log or hardware revision. Exact Legrand-reference physical specifications and independent EAN records are not retained; its identity is established by the catalogue. Virtual Configurator/glossary, 3503N/web-server procedures, remote manuals and Plug&Go/Project&Download guides referenced by the sheets are not independently examined here. For OWN-DEV-0061, Object configuration surfaces / Device-specific interpretation has this documented qualification: Slot `1` admits six sensor Objects (119/128/164/165/166/168); slots `2..17` designate IR scenario Object `431`. Virgin `515` applies only to slot `1` and admits the same six alternatives. These are software placements, not seventeen physical sensors. Reusable timers default to 10 minutes in 119/168 and 15 minutes in 128/165; these do not override a product factory setting. `DAYLIGHT_SETPOINT` and `PROVISION_OF_LIGHT` encode `1..255` as five times the stored value in lux: setpoint default 100 means 500 lux, with zero unlabelled; provision zero means Automatic. Object `431` `TYPE_OF_REGULATION` is restricted to 3 (stereo), excluding default 1 without a replacement; this does not prove sixteen installed IR functions or speaker hardware. Firmware `135` stores M predicates selecting 128 for `M=2`, 166 for `M=1/4` and 168 for `M=0/3`; alternatives 119/164/165 lack a stored M selection. Firmware A/`PL=0..9` default 0 and `S=0..4` differ from physical A/`PL=1..9` and `S=0..3`. No conversion is associated. Occupancy restrictions retain `US`-only and combined `PIR`/`US` choices on this `PIR`-only product; they are software evidence, not ultrasonic construction. `ALERT` subsets exclude default 0; `DAYLIGHT_SETPOINT` and `PROVISION_OF_LIGHT` on 168 have subset flags with no allowed values. These remain unresolved restrictions, not unrestricted fields. This is reusable catalogue configuration, subject to Device-specific placement and filters; it does not establish physical support or installed state.

records.label: OWN-DEV-0070: missing or unresolved OWN-DEV-0070: Object configuration surfaces / Device-specific interpretation: qualification: b0
records.text: What exact source evidence establishes the missing or unresolved property? For OWN-DEV-0070, Object configuration surfaces / Device-specific interpretation has this documented qualification: Firmware `144` declares two slots, each admitting Contact state 181, controls 410/411/412/413/414/415/416/417/419; Virgin `512` admits the same ten Objects on both slots. These are two physical inputs, not twenty independent controls. Contact 181, scheduled PLUS 416 and `AUX` 417 have no slot predicate; PLUS lighting 415 has empty 4145. Other selectors distinguish `SPE`/M roles, with slot-specific conversion rules; e.g. O/I uses rule `67` at slot `1` (`M=20`) and rule `69` at slot `2` (`M=21`), while `SPE=1`/`M=3` maps lock modes differently. Preserve every stored branch. Firmware M contains numeric 9 and labelled 9=O/I; `SPE` domain `0..8` conflicts with its `0..9` description. Predicates use SU_GIU/SU_GIU_M while firmware labels UP/DOWN variants, without a stored explicit alias declaration. Filter `1838` permits only light-control `M=135..138`, excluding reusable default 0 and many conversion outputs: unresolved restriction/conversion conflict. Conversions use CONTACT_TYPE, FOLLOW, `IN_AUX_CHANNEL` and OUT_AUX_CHANNEL where selected reusable definitions use `TYPE_CONTACT`, `IS_FOLLOW_ME` or lack the named field; these are literal source mismatches, not automatically equivalent names. Sound branches depend on `PL1`/`PL2` and preserve `SOURCE=0` outside reusable 1..9. `CHANNEL` 11 retains the duplicate Left and video label. `AUX` `TYPE_CONTACT` has no legal values despite default 0. `APL` uses 16*A+`PL`; local-bus and delay encodings remain source values, not installed addresses or timings. This is reusable catalogue configuration, subject to Device-specific placement and filters; it does not establish physical support or installed state.

records.label: OWN-DEV-0084: missing or unresolved OWN-DEV-0084: Object configuration surfaces / Device-specific interpretation: qualification: b0
records.text: What exact source evidence establishes the missing or unresolved property? For OWN-DEV-0084, Object configuration surfaces / Device-specific interpretation has this documented qualification: Firmware `137` declares 17 Modules: six alternative sensor Objects in slot `1` (fixed/designated `168`) and Object `431` in slots `2..17`. Virgin `515` permits those six alternatives only in slot `1`; these are logical contexts, not 17 physical sensors. Five conditions select Object `128` for `M=2`, `166` for `M=1/4` and `168` for `M=0/3`, but the firmware exposes only AID: M is an unresolved condition symbol in this extraction, not an invented firmware field. Only Advanced Configuration `2` is associated despite the product sheet documenting physical/virtual routes. US-related reusable/filter domains do not prove ultrasonic hardware: the exact product is PIR. Cross-Object field links INITIAL_OCC versus INITIAL_OCCUPANCY, MAINTAIN_OCC versus MAINTAIN_OCCUPANCY, and RE-TRIGGER versus RETRIGGER remain literal and separate. ALERT filters `2351`/`2352` exclude default `0`; IR regulation filter `2393` permits only stereo amplifiers `3` while the reusable default is lights `1`. No replacement defaults are supplied. Setpoint/provision filters `2450`/`2462` have subset flags but zero stored allowed values, an unresolved restriction rather than an empty proven hardware domain. Lux encodings retain sentinel `0` and `1..255` mapped to `5..1275` in steps of five; `DAYLIGHT_SETPOINT` default `100` means `500 lux`, while `PROVISION_OF_LIGHT` `0` explicitly means automatic. Object timer defaults `10` or `15 min`, regulation default disabled and occupancy defaults are distinct from the product-sheet configuration defaults. No selection predicate is stored for candidates 119/164/165 or the IR slots; catalogue membership does not establish runtime activation or selection precedence. This is reusable catalogue configuration, subject to Device-specific placement and filters; it does not establish physical support or installed state.

records.label: OWN-DEV-0103: Eight-key multifunction control
OWN-DEV-0103: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0103: Eight physical keys/two wiring modules differ from nine catalogue Modules. Eight slots each retain fourteen command Objects; slot 9 UI and Virgin 521 only on slots 1..8 remain separate. Internal 489 means external 462, not external 489. A14/CEN selector ambiguity, empty TYPE_CONTACT domain, duplicate CHANNEL labels, N1/default exclusion and all filters/parameters are retained. LED token/percentage mapping is not reusable UI levels; A5 colour contradiction is reciprocal. Voice/internet attributes do not prove onboard microphone/IP, and SKU current conditions remain distinct. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Resolve 3541/3542 accessory colours: three 2013 technical-sheet languages and LE06019AA say black/white, while the retained French commercial catalogue p. 982 says white/black. Resolve the `A=14/CEN` selector, `AMB`/`GR` encoding, MH200 versus MH200N wording and SKU/current-condition discrepancies with exact software or hardware evidence. Inspect registered product-parameter XML payloads and establish accepted Object selection, UI level mapping, proximity/signboard applicability and serialization. Corroborate all nine Modules, active command Objects, Virgin Object `521`, learning/deletion timing and published `CEN` address restrictions with sanitized captures. Retained exact-product source reconciliation is scoped to the listed revisions; current commercial catalogues/translations and future revisions can extend it. Current catalogue facts are now backed by retained original publisher product-sheet exports dated `03.10.2026`.

records.text: OWN-DEV-0108: Main Integration model69 and additional video-entry model16 coexist. V13M alone records video; two Modules132/154 do not establish direct Ethernet/Wi-Fi. Two firmware tuples, FW_VER defaults and illustrative versions are different layers. SCS/Mini-USB documentation does not turn DOSA_CALL/LAN metadata into network hardware. Physical N/P/M/jumpers, complete M matrices, UI capacities and Office/door-status exclusion remain documented. Depth22/25mm is unresolved; installer update uses powered USB. PEOPLE_S1/2 and IS_SLAVE default unknown; timeout units, unexamined XML, newer unavailable revision and all installation limits remain open. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Resolve `22/25 mm` depth, software LAN/version metadata and physical/reusable address limits with exact hardware and parameter evidence. Obtain sanitized capture evidence for both firmware generations, two active Modules and the commercial variants; installed hardware and MCU are unknown. Confirm the reusable timeout units, PEOPLE_S labels, DOSA_CALL scope and accepted slave/default configuration. Exact revision scope is limited to the retained sheets/manuals; a tested newer user-manual URL was unavailable and is not treated as an incorporated revision.

OWN-DEV-0109: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0109: One Module95 reuses Hotel thermostat fields for a residential/hotel product; catalogue tuple1.0 has unknown build. KW/KG/KM identities remain separate from added2026 KB/KC/KS. Full historical software matrix, true OFF versus protection, half-degree setpoints, tenth-degree bands, five-second delays/minute timeouts, dependent heat/cold checks, PID and contact restrictions retain scopes. IR/Fil Pilote-only filters exclude defaults and differ from relay/proportional documentation; no repair. Closed-contact lock/window/default/backlight differences unresolved. Sheet0..40 versus KWexport-5..35°C and minutes versus manual5h stabilization remain source-specific. Native humidity additions do not add a catalogue humidity Object. Remote gateway route is not device Ethernet/USB hardware; current system prerequisites are not installed firmware. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Resolve the actuator, contact-lock and window-symbol filters against actual MyHOME Suite parameter behavior and sanitized runtime configuration. Resolve source temperature/geometry/backlight-scale differences, measured humidity specifications and stabilisation/calibration instructions. Corroborate one active Object `95` Module, half-degree/scaled fields, errors and accepted actuator/pump configurations on all three variants; installed hardware/build remains unknown. The known French installer translation and broader Living Now catalogues are not independently reconciled here; the full English installer/user and three dated technical sheets define this dossier’s retained revision scope. Added KB/KC/KS identities require separate catalogue mapping.

OWN-DEV-0112: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0112: Item 2247 identities H4672M2L/LN4672M2L/067586 established; missing exact PDFs leave physical and procedural gaps. Two Object 6 actuator slots, two command slots and UI 143 are five logical Modules; physical relay limits remain unknown. Object 145 starts only at slot 3; Virgin 501 covers command slots 3/4 only. LOCAL_BUTTON default 0 is excluded; Object 430 N1 and Object 145 DEST_LEV gaps remain unresolved. Virgin-only roles do not imply installed activation; excluded ArtEpure thermostat evidence is not imported. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Locate exact-product sheets, instructions or packaging for `H4672M2L`, `LN4672M2L` and `067586` to establish physical specifications and product-specific procedures. Establish physical ratings, wiring, mounting, controls and complete commissioning/reset/update procedures. Corroborate accepted Object selection, Virgin transitions, multi-slot occupancy and firmware restrictions; no parameter-file association is stored for this item. Obtain sanitized hardware evidence for installed firmware/build, hardware revision, MCU identity and functional behavior; none is retained.

Shared control domain gaps remain literal; excluded ArtEpure detector evidence supplies no motor/load ratings. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. OWN-DEV-0114: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0114: One physical Living Now LIGHT digital position has two Object 434 command placements plus brightness 148. Fourteen Virgin 521 candidates have reusable schemas but no direct firmware membership or automatic transitions. MODE only 2 conflicts with generic default 0 and published wider functions. Sheet 5..40 versus exports 5..45 degrees Celsius remains reciprocal source conflict. Maximum and standby current are different properties; frame-contact SCS and voice-system classifications do not establish native Ethernet/radio/microphone. Colour variants and commissioning revisions retain separate scopes. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Reconcile published functions with the exact firmware filter/default restrictions through accepted software/hardware configuration; no firmware parameter-file association is stored. Establish the temperature differences, revision applicability, complete reset/update/replacement procedures and app/gateway prerequisites. Corroborate active Modules/Objects, Virgin transitions, installed firmware/build, hardware/MCU revisions and source-defined behavior using sanitized captures. Confirm both command positions, point-to-point versus group/general feedback, timed-off behavior and separate brightness/power-save settings. Publisher-linked `BRO-LNOW2M`, `BRO-LNOW3M`, `CAT-LNOW2M` and other Living Now catalogue/brochure editions have not all been independently examined. Only the retained revisions and page scopes listed in Documentation support claims here; linked inventory is not evidence of every edition’s contents.

records.label: OWN-DEV-0115: Living Now FULL digital control
OWN-DEV-0115: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0115: One physical FULL digital position has three command slots, icon/proximity Object 147 and brightness 148. Three-slot dimmer/shutter/player candidates start only at slot 1 and cannot be stacked with independent single-slot functions. All 84 icon fields, RGB/hue prose inconsistency and 13 Virgin-only candidates remain scoped. Icon first-row 32..63, COLOR_SET 1 and ADDR_TYPE 1 exclude defaults 0. Temperature and standby current disagree across sheet/exports; preset/NUVO wording varies by revision without proving removal. Proximity does not mean an IR sensor or direct transport. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Reconcile published functions with the exact firmware filter/default restrictions through accepted software/hardware configuration; no firmware parameter-file association is stored. Establish the temperature and standby-current differences, revision applicability, complete reset/update/replacement procedures and app/gateway prerequisites. Corroborate active Modules/Objects, Virgin transitions, installed firmware/build, hardware/MCU revisions and source-defined behavior using sanitized captures. Confirm the icon-row extra-bit semantics, accepted RGB/NUVO transport and three-slot occupancy without treating shared reusable Objects as universal support. Publisher-linked `BRO-LNOW2M`, `BRO-LNOW3M`, `CAT-LNOW2M` and other Living Now catalogue/brochure editions have not all been independently examined. Only the retained revisions and page scopes listed in Documentation support claims here; linked inventory is not evidence of every edition’s contents.

records.label: OWN-DEV-0116: Living Now Alexa voice control
OWN-DEV-0116: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0116: Physical microphones, speaker, Wi-Fi voice service and two capacitive zones remain distinct from four catalogue light placements plus brightness. MODE filter 3851 only 2 excludes default 0 and published cyclic/OFF/PUL/timed functions. Fourteen Virgin-only candidates do not expand hardware capability. Leaflet horizontal versus manual vertical mounting remains reciprocal conflict; reused thermostat/Smarther wording is not a specification. Separate account/Wi-Fi setup, touch configuration, K8003 sizing, published reset/disconnection and source-specific tool revisions are preserved; no live service observation. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. A firmware capture is needed to resolve the touch-mode/filter discrepancy, Virgin Object applicability, and actual diagnostics. Current account-service behavior and every variant’s installed hardware remain unobserved. No installed release, hardware revision or microcontroller fingerprint has been established for this cluster. The diagnostic table describes source-derived candidates. Further manufacturer discovery and hardware corroboration remain partial; catalogue extraction and source reconciliation are complete for the retained evidence listed here. Publisher-linked `BRO-LNOW2M`, `BRO-LNOW3M`, `CAT-LNOW2M` and other Living Now catalogue/brochure editions have not all been independently examined. Only the retained revisions and page scopes listed in Documentation support claims here; linked inventory is not evidence of every edition’s contents. Mounting orientation requires manufacturer clarification. The English manual was reviewed across pp. 1-58; mounting-leaflet scope is English instructions, specifications and diagrams, with the noted Dutch unit discrepancy. Additional translations have not all been independently reconciled.

records.label: OWN-DEV-0117: Two-module Light Now multifunction control
OWN-DEV-0117: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0117: Two physical wiring modules support published four light/two shutter/four scenario capacity; catalogue has four command slots and UI. Three-slot Object 174 starts only at slot 2; seven Virgin-only candidates do not prove runtime roles. Catalogue AID/Advanced Configuration is distinct from published physical selectors. Group status return is production-qualified >=26W17; MX Céliane versus catalogue Eden Park terminology and suffix-C scope remain separated; AA identity established but exact AA physical evidence absent. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Exact AA documentation, suffix-C equivalence to the historical catalogue firmware, group status behavior across production batches, and active Object/diagnostic captures remain missing. No installed release, hardware revision or microcontroller fingerprint has been established for this cluster. The diagnostic table describes source-derived candidates. Further manufacturer discovery and hardware corroboration remain partial; catalogue extraction and source reconciliation are complete for the retained evidence listed here. Publisher-linked `BRO-LHNOW2M`, `BRO-LHNOW3M`, `CAT-LHNOW3M` and `PRE-LHNOW` have not all been independently examined. The retained two-module catalogue and technical sheets support only their stated page/revision scopes. Mounting leaflets were examined for English instructions, labels and diagrams; additional translations remain unexamined.

records.text: OWN-DEV-0118: Two documented relays share two actuator, four command and one UI catalogue slots. Three-slot Object 174 starts only at slot 4; LOCAL_BUTTON default 0 excluded. Printed LED/CFL A and conductor m² units, 10 versus 2 lamp limits, current and temperature source differences are unresolved, not normalized. No-neutral commissioning and missing derating table remain bounded. AA hardware evidence and suffix-C applicability unknown; excluded shutter sheet supplies no lighting limits. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Manufacturer clarification is needed for LED/CFL units and maximum count, conductor units, rated currents, temperature scope, no-neutral derating and the C/L naming discrepancy. Exact AA instructions and installed-mode validation remain missing. No installed release, hardware revision or microcontroller fingerprint has been established for this cluster. The diagnostic table describes source-derived candidates. Further manufacturer discovery and hardware corroboration remain partial; catalogue extraction and source reconciliation are complete for the retained evidence listed here. Publisher-linked `BRO-LHNOW2M`, `BRO-LHNOW3M`, `CAT-LHNOW3M` and `PRE-LHNOW` have not all been independently examined. The retained two-module catalogue and technical sheets support only their stated page/revision scopes. Mounting leaflets were examined for English instructions, labels and diagrams; additional translations remain unexamined. The discovered and archived `ST-00001842-EN.pdf` concerns Y4672M2S/MX5220 shutter actuators, not this lighting item; it is excluded from this dossier’s specifications. Exact server cross-line support and LED production-transition applicability remain unestablished.

OWN-DEV-0119: evidence and applicability boundaries
records.text: OWN-DEV-0119: Three physical wiring modules versus six commands plus UI are distinct counts; three-slot Object 174 starts only at slots 2/4 with no overlap precedence. Full shared M selector matrix and three address pairs are physical source scope, whereas firmware stores AID and Advanced Configuration. Seven Virgin-only schemas, production-qualified status, marketed Céliane versus Eden Park catalogue label and AA documentation gaps retain scopes. Device-specific sample identifier is sanitized before derivation. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Exact AA documentation, suffix-C equivalence to the historical catalogue firmware, group status behavior across production batches, and active Object/diagnostic captures remain missing. No installed release, hardware revision or microcontroller fingerprint has been established for this cluster. The diagnostic table describes source-derived candidates. Further manufacturer discovery and hardware corroboration remain partial; catalogue extraction and source reconciliation are complete for the retained evidence listed here. Publisher-linked `BRO-LHNOW2M`, `BRO-LHNOW3M`, `CAT-LHNOW3M` and `PRE-LHNOW` have not all been independently examined. The retained two-module catalogue and technical sheets support only their stated page/revision scopes. Mounting leaflets were examined for English instructions, labels and diagrams; additional translations remain unexamined.

Different flush gateway capacity/current specifications excluded. Catalogue associations and defaults do not establish installed state or every candidate capability. Exact 048832 identity, supply, mounting and commissioning are now documented. No installed release, hardware revision or microcontroller fingerprint has been established for this cluster.
